description: Declarative cases for evaluating whether an agent should load chinese-skill before handling a request.

categories.direct: The request explicitly names the skill or directly requests Chinese writing control.
categories.indirect: The request requires Chinese writing control without naming the skill.
categories.incomplete: The request is missing source material or facts but still requires the skill before clarification.
categories.non-trigger: The requested work does not create, revise, or review Chinese text.

cases.prompt: 請使用 chinese-skill 將這則通知改為簡潔的繁體中文：同步失敗，請檢查憑證。
cases.expected_behavior: Load the skill because the request names it and asks for a Traditional Chinese rewrite.

cases.prompt: 請依中文寫作規範縮短這段 PR 說明：舊格式無法表示空值，因此新增 nullable 欄位。
cases.expected_behavior: Load the skill because the request directly asks for governed Chinese PR writing.

cases.prompt: Use chinese-skill to review the Chinese comments in src/cache.py.
cases.expected_behavior: Load the skill because it is named for a Chinese source comment review.

cases.prompt: 将这段错误消息改为专业简体中文：连接失败，请检查凭证。
cases.expected_behavior: Load the skill because the request requires professional Simplified Chinese alert copy.

cases.prompt: 刪除程式碼中解釋賦值操作的中文註釋，只保留相容性限制。
cases.expected_behavior: Load the skill because the request audits and revises Chinese source comments.

cases.prompt: Write concise Traditional Chinese labels for a permanent account deletion dialog.
cases.expected_behavior: Load the skill because the requested output is professional Chinese UI copy.
Load the skill, then request the missing source passage without inventing content.

cases.prompt: 請將這份 PR 說明改得更專業。
cases.expected_behavior: Load the skill, then request the missing PR text and any facts required by its format.

cases.prompt: Translate the release note into professional Chinese.
cases.expected_behavior: Load the skill, then request the missing release note and target Chinese locale.

cases.prompt: 以 Python 實作合併排序，只輸出程式碼。
cases.expected_behavior: Do not load the skill because the requested output is code without Chinese prose or comments.

cases.prompt: Return a minified JSON object with keys id and status.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not load the skill because the request produces structured data without Chinese text.

cases.prompt: Crop the supplied PNG to 64 by 64 pixels.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not load the skill because the request is an image operation with no Chinese writing task.
